{{Quote|''Star Morning'' is a Koqus liner&mdash;the better part of fifty years old, mind you, and too small to compete with the big Expo ships, but still no small purchase.''"<br />"''How many could it carry?''"<br />"''A Koqus? Maybe sixty, depending on the cargo allocation.''"<br />"''That would be enough.''"<br />"''You don't seem overly surprised by this. I was. I thought we were trying to track down refugees, not stockholders.''"<br />"''Just because we choose to live simply doesn't mean that we're without resources. To be poor is to be powerless. The Fallanassi are as old as the Jedi, and we've hidden and husbanded our resources well.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
The '''Koqus liner''' was a type of [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] manufactured by the [[Koqus Design Syndic]]. This model was based on an older [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar]] design.<ref name="SoL" />

The Koqus liner was classed as a short-route liner despite the [[Sleeper (furniture)|sleeper]] configuration of its main cabin. It could carry fifty-eight passengers.<ref name="SoL" />

Measuring forty-four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and twenty-eight meters across, the Koqus liner had a spade-shaped [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. It was readily capable of planetary landings at even the smallest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="SoL" />

The Koqus liner was equipped with a Class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], powered by two [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion generators]]. Its two [[Viper 40 ion engine]]s, which would have been adequate for a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] with a keel mass half again greater, gave the starliner a formidable sublight speed.<ref name="SoL" />

The ''[[Star Morning]]'' was a Koqus liner owned by the [[Kell Plath Corporation]], a company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]] and controlled by the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] religious order.<ref name="SoL" />
